Class ManagerPage

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.awt.Component
      • java.awt.Container
        • javax.swing.JComponent
          • javax.swing.JPanel
            • ManagerPage
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.awt.image.ImageObserver, java.awt.MenuContainer, java.io.Serializable, javax.accessibility.Accessible
    class ManagerPage
extends javax.swing.JPanel
    Represents the Manager dashboard in the Point of Sale system. Handles extensive administrative tasks including inventory management, menu configuration, employee tracking, order voiding, and comprehensive reporting (X/Z Reports, Sales Charts).
